3. **Tutankhamun’s tomb is not open for general public entry.** Since 2018, access to KV62 has been extremely restricted due to preservation concerns. Only a very limited number of visitors per day are allowed, and tickets must be booked months in advance through official Egyptian authorities. Most tourists view a replica or the nearby Valley of the Kings museum instead.
